comment: Base class for buffers with flags.

methods.name: public final boolean isDecodeOnly()
methods.comment: Returns whether the {@link C#BUFFER_FLAG_DECODE_ONLY} flag is set.

methods.name: public final boolean isEndOfStream()
methods.comment: Returns whether the {@link C#BUFFER_FLAG_END_OF_STREAM} flag is set.

methods.name: public final boolean isKeyFrame()
methods.comment: Returns whether the {@link C#BUFFER_FLAG_KEY_FRAME} flag is set.

methods.name: public final boolean hasSupplementalData()
methods.comment: Returns whether the {@link C#BUFFER_FLAG_HAS_SUPPLEMENTAL_DATA} flag is set.

methods.name: public final void setFlags(@C.BufferFlags int flags)
methods.comment:
* Replaces this buffer's flags with {@code flags}.
   *
   * @param flags The flags to set, which should be a combination of the {@code C.BUFFER_FLAG_*}
   *     constants.

methods.name: public final void addFlag(@C.BufferFlags int flag)
methods.comment:
* Adds the {@code flag} to this buffer's flags.
   *
   * @param flag The flag to add to this buffer's flags, which should be one of the {@code
   *     C.BUFFER_FLAG_*} constants.

methods.name: public final void clearFlag(@C.BufferFlags int flag)
methods.comment:
* Removes the {@code flag} from this buffer's flags, if it is set.
   *
   * @param flag The flag to remove.

methods.name: protected final boolean getFlag(@C.BufferFlags int flag)
methods.comment:
* Returns whether the specified flag has been set on this buffer.
   *
   * @param flag The flag to check.
   * @return Whether the flag is set.
